notes.title: Kaetram v2.3.3 - THE Update

- Fixed Iron recipes needing Aquasillius.
- Fixes inconsistencies with healing items.
- Fixed hide equipment issues when logging in.

We've also worked to add a few quality of life options, as well as sound effects for walking. The full change-log is as follows:

[b]All items are now dropped upon death

Combat logout timer is now in effect, closing client during mob combat will persist combat for 60 seconds, closing client during PVP will persist combat for as long as you are attacked.

This one is a small update we put together this past week to address many bug fixes, quality-of-life additions, and some new content. The highlight of this update is the complete rework of our economy, and adjusting the prices for all the items in the game. Yes, that's right, we've gone through all 1500 items one by one and adjusted the prices to better reflect their value. We've also added customizable keybinds among other things. notes.title: Kaetram v2.2.2
notes.content:
This is our first major content update in quite some time! With our last couple of patches focusing on addressing all the desync issues, we are finally able to focus on adding new bosses and mechanics. We have worked tirelessly to add new music, items, recipes, quests, achievements, and much more. The spotlight for this update goes to the instancing system, you may now reserve special instances to fight bosses (currently exclusive to the new bosses but more may be added.) This system is still in its infancy and may receive more updates and tweaks as we progress.

Note: If there are no more players in an instance, all the items get despawned. Dying in an instance alone is risky because the instance will self-destruct upon your death.

Secondly, we have opened up two new areas in the game. The extended lava area and Chymos (the red forest.) These areas will continue receiving updates and will be expanded in the upcoming updates.

In our upcoming updates we want to focus on reworking our PvP mechanics and adding minigames. We expect to release our Christmas event sometime around December 15th.

This will be the last major update for the year, the development team will be going on a break from December 15th until early January. We expect to resume regular updates somewhere around January 14th. Thank you everyone for an amazing year!

notes.title: Kaetram v2.2.0 - Stonk Market, Spells, and Translations
notes.content:
Kaetram v2.2.0 comes in just three days before our anniversary. We've been working tirelessly for this past month to crank our some much-needed content. We have finally added translations for Portuguese, Spanish, Dutch, Russian, Tagalog, and Norwegian. The translations cover the interface, quest dialogs, and server messages. Additional languages will be added in future updates. The Stonk Exchange is by far our biggest feature so far. It allows cross-world trading between players. Simply place a sale or purchase order and go about your day. Though the system is functioning as expected, further tweaks will be made in the future, including the ability to see what items/and amounts are currently on the exchange. Finally, this update brings magic spells, which will slowly phase out the old magic system. That is not all however, the full change-log for this update is as follows:

notes.title: Kaetram v2.0.6
notes.content:
This is a minor update to fix all the bugs reported on our Discord server. We were originally planning to focus solely on the next big update however this cluster of bugs was affecting the gameplay considerably, so we decided to push out an early update to fix as many as possible. The following is the complete changelog:

- Added search functionality to stores.
- Added leaderboards username wrapping.
- Added more Frost Goblins around Duhvic.
- Fixes lootbags not appearing.
- Fixes players sometimes not appearing.
- Fixes Queen Ant boss causing lag spikes.
- Fixes guild username input length.
- Fixes main menu moving locations upon startup when screen is resized.
- Fixes arrow/key movement opening bank improperly.
- Fixes party invite username length, username formatting, and joining/leaving/kick messages.
- Fixes stun lock stopping being choppy.
- Fixes death screen interface becoming stuck if the inventory or any other UI was open.
- Fixes encryption-related issues causing packets to get lost.
- Fixes skill element UI issues with the progress bar.
- Fixes disconnection issues when battling many mobs at once.
- Fixes weapon enchantments available on bows not working on melee weapons (e.g. stun).
- Fixes bank deposit to make items go into the currently open tab.
- Fixes issues with following and reworks the whole interaction system.
- Fixes random event mobs spawning in walls.
- Fixes pet reappearing if picked up while moving.
- Updated fish prices for all fishes.
- More forageables are now stackable.
- Increased snow potion and fire potion duration to 5 minutes.
- Improves divinity and enchanter interface selection.
- Improves bank loading time and decreases network usage.
- Disabled unnecessary drag and dropping in the trading interface.

We have tried our best to fix all the desynchronization issues with mobs and players appearing in the wrong places.  We have also upgraded to the latest Godot build, which offers many improvements to the engine itself. The change-log is as follows:

- Added collection log.
- Added CTRL + Click to drop items.
- Removed guest login.
- Increased skilling enchant proc rate.
- Fixes to mob/player syncing. Should resolve most issues, please report any remaining discrepancies (if any).
- Fixes to party system updating kills for all members.
- Fixes random event mob not spawning correctly.
- Fixes black lines causing by zooming floating-point errors.
- Fixes players not appearing sometimes.
- Fixes resources appearing as empty.
- Reworked slime helmet sprites.
- Minor UI tweaks and fixes.
- Minor fixes around the map with entities getting stuck.
- Many backend security improvements.
